MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_PEN.title: Hero's pen
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_PEN.description: At the beginning of each battle, obtain 3 layers of [color=#CC6666] [Justice] [/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_PEN.flavor: [color=#CC6666] The pen that Hiro [/color] used in junior high school should have been given to Snow.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCH_FACTOR.title: Witch factor
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCH_FACTOR.descript: When you play an attack card, you get 20 layers of [b] [Witch Transformation] [/b]. When you play a skill or ability card, you get 10 layers of [b] [Witch Transformation] [/b]. (Sometimes the card may be played automatically)
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCH_FACTOR.flavor: When the witch factor is overactive, people will lose their minds and become monster-like beings, who are regarded as dangerous individuals that must be eliminated.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITHHIRO.title: The object possessed by the great witch
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITHHIRO.description:
[color=#CC6666] "Snow...you are wrong" [/color]
Obtain 6 layers of [color=#CC6666] [Justice] [/color] at the beginning of each battle
At the beginning of the round, you can choose a card from your hand and return it to the draw pile.
When you get [b] [Suspect] [/b] for the first time in this battle, it will be reduced by two levels.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITHHIRO.flavor:
[color=#CC6666] "But...I still want to find [/color][color=#CCCCCC] you [/color][color=#CC6666]" [/color]
[color=#CC6666] "I'm going to find you now————To judge our [/color][b] [Crime] [/b][color=#CC6666]" [/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCHGRIMOIRE.title: Witch information
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCHGRIMOIRE.descrip: When obtained, 26 cards are randomly generated from the prepared witch cards, and any number can be selected to be added to the deck.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCHGRIMOIRE.flavor: There is a large amount of information about material transactions between the island and the mansion, as well as information about the girls in custody. There are also personal information and face photos of Emma and all of them on it. Interpretation seems to take a lot of time
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCHGRIMOIRE.selecti: Choose the cards you want to add to your deck
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_DISMANTLEDPARTS.title: Disassembled parts
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_DISMANTLEDPARTS.descr: Obtained every round{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}. In the first round, all attack cards are automatically played against random enemy targets.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_DISMANTLEDPARTS.flavo: Parts of a crossbow in a barrel in the corridor. It was dismantled to pieces and difficult to repair.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MAGICSNIPERRIFLE.desc: Gain 1 ammo point for each node entered (maximum 6 points). Right-click to consume 1 point of ammunition and add a [b] [Bullet] [/b] to your hand.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MAGICSNIPERRIFLE.flav: The maximum loading capacity is 6 rounds. It is a weapon made with magic by a girl who lived in the prison in the past. When the date changes, 1 bullet will be automatically loaded
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_BLOODIEDCLOTHING.desc: Lost 26 points [b] maximum life limit [/b]. All skill cards in the deck will be enchanted with [b] [Smartness] [/b].
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_BLOODIEDCLOTHING.flav: [color=#CC6666] memories of the past [/color], [color=#ff99cc] clothes of the past [/color], friends [color=#cccccc] of the past [/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_FRUITPLATE.title: fruit plate in memory
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_FRUITPLATE.descriptio: When obtained, select 1 card in the deck and enchant it to get [color=#ff99cc][b] [Emma’s Apple] [/b][/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_FRUITPLATE.flavor: That was the fruit plate brought by Emma in the afternoon a long time ago
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_SAFE.title: safe
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_SAFE.description: When obtained, get 2 random ancient relics
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_SAFE.flavor:
Opened safe.
It's a digital combination lock, and there's blood on the numeric keypad.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MAGICALSKETCHBOOK.des: At the beginning of each battle, obtain 3 layers of [b] [Crimson Butterfly] [/b].
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MAGICALSKETCHBOOK.fla:
Natsume Anan's sketchbook.
It has a painting of a butterfly on it.
The author of the painting is Noah, and the butterfly seems to be some kind of protection left to An An.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MLLNOTE.title: notes
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MLLNOTE.description: When obtained, remove all [color=#CC6666] [Death Recall] [/color] in the deck, and then obtain a new [color=#CC6666] [Death Recall] [/color].
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MLLNOTE.flavor: The contract reads: Trade the end of the old for a new beginning.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_RITUALSWORD.title: ceremonial sword
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_RITUALSWORD.descripti: When obtained, add a [b] [Witch's Rest Ritual] [/b] to the deck.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_RITUALSWORD.flavor: A beautifully decorated sword. Previously placed in a safe. No signs of use
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_EXTERNALINFORMATION.d: After the battle, you can select 3 cards to upgrade at the beginning of the next battle round, or you can choose not to upgrade. Every time a card is upgraded, 2 points of [b], the maximum life limit of [/b], are lost.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_EXTERNALINFORMATION.f: The price of intelligence is always heavier than imagined
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_EMA_WITCH_FACTOR.desc: When you play an attack card, you gain 20 layers of [b] [Witch Transformation] [/b]. When you play a skill or ability card, you gain 10 layers of [b] [Witch Transformation] [/b].
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_EMA_WITCH_FACTOR.flav: When the witch factor is overactive, people will lose their minds and become monster-like beings, who are regarded as dangerous individuals that must be eliminated.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_EMA_TRIAL_BADGE.title: Relics of friends
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_EMA_TRIAL_BADGE.descr: At the beginning of the battle, add [color=#339966] [[/color][color=#cc9966] Judgment [/color][color=#6699cc] Judgment [/color][color=#339966]] [/color] enchantment to the card based on the keywords. Randomly add [color=#339966] [[/color][color=#cc9966] [/color][color=#6699cc] [/color][color=#339966]] [/color] components to each of the three cards randomly. The enchantment counter is reset every turn.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_EMA_TRIAL_BADGE.flavo: The pen left behind after the death of [color=#CC6666] Hero [/color] has special meaning to [color=#ff99cc] Emma [/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITHEMA.title: Emma's Mask
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITHEMA.description:
[color=#ff99cc] "But now I can meet Xiaoxue again, I'm really happy" [/color]
At the beginning of the battle, randomly add [color=#339966] [[/color][color=#cc9966] Judgment [/color][color=#6699cc] Judgment [/color][color=#339966]] [/color] components at the beginning of the round. Add 1 card each to the hand and discard pile to add a random [color=#339966] [[/color][color=#cc9966] trial [/color][color=#6699cc] judgment [/color][color=#339966]] [/color] component
When [color=#ff99cc] "Close" [/color] reaches 7 for the first time, a zero-cost [color=#ff99cc] "Close" [/color] card is generated.
When [color=#CC6666] "Alienation" [/color] reaches 7 for the first time, choose 1 card in your hand to become a zero-cost [color=#CC6666] "Alienation" [/color] card
At the end of the round, 30 layers of [b] [Witch Transformation] [/b] will be reduced.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITHEMA.flavor: [color=#ff99cc] "Let's create a future together... where even the magic that kills witches no longer exists!" [/color]
Choose 5 cards from Sakuraba Emma's card pool and add them to the deck
SEA_GLASS.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HIRO.de: Select 5 cards from Nikaido Hiro's card pool and add them to the deck
SEA_GLASS.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_SHERRYL: Choose 5 cards from Tachibana Shirley's card pool and add them to the deck
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MAGNIFYING_GLASS.desc: [color=#33ccff]【Reversal】[/color]: When the draw pile is empty, swap the cards in the consumption pile with the cards in the discard pile. Every time you successfully exchange one card, you will get 2 layers of [color=#33ccff] [Tangerine Shirley's Magic] [/color] (when the card is removed, it cannot be obtained again in this battle, and it will be automatically removed when the curse/status/ancient is consumed)
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MAGNIFYING_GLASS.flav: Detective Tachibana Shirley’s identity is [color=#33ccff] [symbol] [/color], but no one can guess what she saw with her [magnifying glass]
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCHIFICATION_EMOTIO:
When [b] [Witch Transformation] [/b] reaches level 100, get 1 [b] [Witch Transformation] [/b][rainbow][b] [Emotion] [/b][/rainbow] card and add it to your hand.
[b][rainbow][b] [Basic emotion] [/b][/rainbow]: [purple] [Happy] [/purple], [color=#ffcc99] [Sad] ZXQ16QX Z, [color=#CC6666] [anger] [/color], [color=#ff99cc] [fear] [/color], [color=#6666cc] [disgust] [/color], [color=#cc9966] [surprise] [/color]
[color=#33ccff] Emotion Fusion Formula [/color]:
[purple]【Happy】[/purple]+[color=#ffcc99]【Sad】[/color] → [color=#999999]【Sad】[/color]
[color=#CC6666]【Angry】[/color]+[color=#ff99cc]【Fear】[/color] → [color=#ff9966]【Annoyance】[/color]
[color=#ffcc99]【Sadness】[/color]+[color=#ff99cc]【Fear】[/color] → [color=#ff0000]【Sadness】[/color]
[color=#6666cc]【disgusted】[/color]+[color=#cc9966]【surprised】[/color] → [gold]【horrified】[/gold]
[purple]【Happy】[/purple]+[color=#cc9966]【Surprised】[/color] → [blue]【Excited】[/blue][/b]
6 kinds of [rainbow][b] [Basic emotions] [/b][/rainbow]+[b][color=33ccff] [Curiosity] [/color][/b]+ZXQ66 QXZ[b]【Helpless】[/b][/green]→[b][color=#33ccff]「Friendship [/color][green]」[/green][/b]
The power of the witch comes from the inner [color=#ff99cc] [emotion] [/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_XUELICHOUMA.title: Tachibana Shirley's chips
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_XUELICHOUMA.descripti:
In the [color=#33ccff] battle room [/color] you can choose to right-click this relic once per round to consume 10 [gold] gold coins [/gold] to add a random card to your hand.
[color=#33ccff] [/color] outside the battle room consumes 100[gold] gold coins [/gold] to get a random card reward
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_XUELICHOUMA.flavor: If you are lucky enough, you may get a card of [color=#33ccff] and unexpected [/color]
